# Read in the flights data



```{python}
url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byuidatascience/data4missing/master/data-raw/flights_missing/flights_missing.json"
response = requests.get(url)
response.raise_for_status()
df = pl.read_json(io.BytesIO(response.content))

df.head()
```

# Give it a quick once-over



```{python}
df.schema
```

# Question 1: Seasons
use 'with_columns' to correct 'Febuary' to 'February' and create a seasons column
```{python}
df_season = (
    df.with_columns(
        # .replace is used for bad data, to target and replace it
        pl.col("month").replace("Febuary", "February").alias("month")
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.when(pl.col("month").is_in(["January", "February", "Devember"])).then(pl.lit("Winter"))
        .when(pl.col("month").is_in(["April", "May", "March"])).then(pl.lit("Spring"))
        .when(pl.col("month").is_in(["July", "August", "June"])).then(pl.lit("Summer"))
        .when(pl.col("month").is_in(["October", "November", "September"])).then(pl.lit("Fall"))
        .otherwise(pl.lit("Unknown"))
        .alias("season")
    )
)
# df_season
df_season.select("month", "season").unique().sort("month")
```

# Gather all columns whose names start with num_of.
```{python}
num_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col.startswith("num_of")]
minute_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col.startswith("minutes_delayed")]
# See if you can do it without a for loop! is there a function?
num_cols
```

# filter out problematic values like -999 or 1500+ and divide by 1000

```{python}
df_season_clean = (
    df_season.with_columns(
        pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier")
        .replace("1500+", 1500)
        .cast(pl.Int64)
    ).with_columns(
        pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft")
        .replace(-999, None)
        .fill_null(pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft").mean())
    )
)
```
